environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default runtime configuration. The Go binary runs as non-root user 'appuser' (uid 1000) but has read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (misconfigured permissions), and other sensitive host-mapped volumes at /app/data/../../etc/. No seccomp profile applied. Container uses default Docker capabilities.

config.filesystem_permissions: sensitive files world-readable due to legacy volume mount
config.network: public ALB with no WAF rules
